drillParagraphs.answer: If the police catch criminals, they arrest them and take them to the police station

drillParagraphs.answer: The expression "so far, so good" means that somebody has not experienced any problems up to now

drillParagraphs.answerZh: “到目前为止，一切都很好”这句话的意思是到目前为止某人还没有遇到任何问题

drillParagraphs.question: For example: "Can you speak Spanish?"?

drillParagraphs.question: "Will she be working?"?
drillParagraphs.answer: "Yes, she will." Notice that only the first auxiliary verb is necessary. Instead of "Yes, she will be", we can just say "Yes, she will". Answer the following questions with short answers:

drillParagraphs.answerZh: “是的，她会的。”请注意，只有第一个助动词是必要的。我们可以说“是的，她会的”，而不是“是的，她会的”。用简短的答案回答以下问题：

drillParagraphs.question: Will we still be here in two minutes' time?

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，我可以〜不，我不能

drillParagraphs.question: "Has he got the money?"?

drillParagraphs.answer: Yes, I have For short answers with the present simple and past simple, we use the auxiliary "do".

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 是的，我有 对于一般现在时和一般过去时的简短回答，我们使用助词“do”。

drillParagraphs.answer: Two other words for "ill" are "sick" and "unwell"

drillParagraphs.answer: The three forms of "catch" are "catch, caught, caught"

vocabulary.meaningEn: A piece of information describing, or an account of certain events given or presented to someone, with the most common adpositions being by (referring to creator of the report) and on (referring to the subject).
To turn (something) upside down or inside out; to place in a contrary order or direction.
(in the plural) A type of ladies' shoes with very low heels.
A feeling of sympathy at the misfortune or suffering of someone or something.
(usually followed by "with," but also sometimes "would" or "might," especially in finance) In some manner or degree; in part; partly. See also what with
An informal social gathering, usually in a natural outdoor setting, to which the participants bring their own food and drink.
To express (an action, thought or idea) by means of particular words.

drillParagraphs.question: What are the two ways in which we can repeat what someone has said?
drillParagraphs.answer: The two ways … are by giving the exact words of the speaker, or by reporting what the speaker said
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们可以通过哪两种方式重复别人说过的话？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 有两种方法……一是准确说出说话者的话，二是报告说话者所说的内容

drillParagraphs.question: What do we call these two ways?
drillParagraphs.answer: We call these two ways direct speech and indirect speech
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 我们怎么称呼这两种方式呢？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们把这两种方式称为直接引语和间接引语

drillParagraphs.question: What do we do with the tenses when we change direct speech into indirect speech?
drillParagraphs.answer: When we change …, we generally move the verb into the past
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当我们将直接引语改为间接引语时，我们如何处理时态？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们改变……时，我们通常将动词移至过去

drillParagraphs.question: What do we do if a verb is already in the past?
drillParagraphs.answer: If a verb …, it often remains unchanged, but sometimes we put it further into the past
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 如果动词已经过去了怎么办？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果动词……，它通常保持不变，但有时我们把它进一步推入过去

drillParagraphs.question: What do we do with the word "will" when we change direct speech into indirect speech?
drillParagraphs.answer: When we change …, we change the word "will" to "would" Give me an example, please. She said that John would go to London next year
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 当我们把直接引语改为间接引语时，我们如何处理“意志”这个词呢？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们改变……时，我们将“will”一词改为“would”，请给我一个例子。她说约翰明年要去伦敦

drillParagraphs.question: What are the two basic types of auxiliary verb in English?
drillParagraphs.answer: The two basic types of auxiliary verb in English are primary auxiliaries and modal auxiliaries
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 英语助动词有哪两种基本类型？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 英语助动词的两种基本类型是主助动词和情态助动词

drillParagraphs.question: What are the primary auxiliaries?
drillParagraphs.answer: The primary auxiliaries are the verbs "be", "have" and "do" We use the auxiliary "be" to make the continuous tenses, for example when we say "I am speaking English now". We also use it for the passive voice, for example when we say "This book was printed in England".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 主要辅助剂有哪些？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 主要助动词是动词“be”、“have”和“do”。我们使用助动词“be”来构成进行时态，例如当我们说“我现在正在说英语”时。我们也将它用于被动语态，例如当我们说“这本书是在英国印刷的”时。

drillParagraphs.question: When do we use the auxiliary "be"?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the auxiliary "be" to make the continuous tenses and the passive voice
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么时候用助动词“be”？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们使用助词“be”来构成进行时态和被动语态

drillParagraphs.question: When do we use the auxiliary "have"?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the auxiliary "have" for the perfect tenses
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么时候用助动词“have”？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们使用助词“have”来表示完成时态

drillParagraphs.question: When do we use the auxiliary "do"?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the auxiliary "do" for the present simple and past simple
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 什么时候用助动词“do”？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们使用助动词“do”来表示一般现在时和一般过去时

drillParagraphs.question: What are the ten common modals?
drillParagraphs.answer: The ten common modals are "can", "could", "will", "would", "may", "might", "shall", "should", "must" and "ought"

drillParagraphs.question: 1) What's the difference between these two sentences: "I must study" and "I should study"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The difference between those two sentences is that "I must study" means that I have no alternative, whereas "I should study" means I have alternatives but that studying is the right thing for me to do.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 1）“我必须学习”和“我应该学习”这两句话有什么区别？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这两句话的区别在于，“我必须学习”意味着我别无选择，而“我应该学习”意味着我有选择，但学习对我来说是正确的事情。

drillParagraphs.question: 2) What can we use instead of "would be able" in conditional sentences?
drillParagraphs.answer: Give me an example. We can use "could" instead of "would be able" in conditional sentences. For example, "If I was a bird, I could fly".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 2）在条件句中我们可以用什么来代替“would be possible”？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 举个例子。在条件句中我们可以用“could”代替“would be beable”。例如，“如果我是一只鸟，我就能飞翔”。

drillParagraphs.question: 4) What are the two ways of forming the 2nd conditional with the verb "to be"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The two ways of forming the 2nd conditional with the verb "to be" are "if I was" and "if I were".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 4) 用动词“to be”构成第二个条件句的两种方式是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 用动词“to be”构成第二个条件句的两种方式是“if I was”和“if I were”。

drillParagraphs.question: 5) What's the difference between "for" and "since"? Give me some?
drillParagraphs.answer: examples. The difference between "for" and "since" is that we use the word "for" when we say a period of time, whereas we use the word "since" when we say the time at which a period began. For example, "for half an hour"; "for two weeks"; "since six o'clock"; "since last June".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 5）“因为”和“因为”有什么区别？给我一些吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 例子。 “for”和“since”之间的区别在于，当我们说一段时间时，我们使用“for”一词，而当我们说一个时期开始的时间时，我们使用“since”一词。例如“半个小时”； “两周”； “从六点钟开始”； “从去年六月开始”。

drillParagraphs.question: 6) When do we use the past continuous? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the past continuous for an action that was in progress at a particular time in the past. For example, "I was speaking English at this time yesterday".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 6) 什么时候使用过去进行时？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们用过去进行时来表示过去某个特定时间正在进行的动作。例如，“昨天这个时候我正在说英语”。

drillParagraphs.question: 7) What is the most common use of the past continuous? Give me an?
drillParagraphs.answer: example. The most common use of the past continuous is to say that an action was in progress when another action happened. For example, "I was cooking lunch when she arrived".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 7) 过去进行时最常见的用法是什么？给我一个？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 例子。过去进行时最常见的用法是表示一个动作正在进行时另一个动作发生。例如，“她到达时我正在做饭”。

drillParagraphs.question: 8) What does the active voice communicate?
drillParagraphs.answer: The active voice communicates that the subject does the action.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 8) 主动语态传达什么信息？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 主动语态传达主语执行该动作的信息。

drillParagraphs.question: 9) What does the passive voice communicate?
drillParagraphs.answer: The passive voice communicates that the subject receives the action.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 9) 被动语态传达什么信息？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 被动语态表明主语接受了动作。

drillParagraphs.question: 10) How do we form the passive voice?
drillParagraphs.answer: We form the passive voice with the verb "to be" and a past participle.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 10) 如何构成被动语态？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们用动词“to be”和过去分词构成被动语态。

drillParagraphs.question: 13) What three things can the words "in spite of" and "despite" be followed by? Give me an example of each?
drillParagraphs.answer: "In spite of" and "despite" can be followed by a noun, or "-ing", or "the fact that dsshdu". For example, "In spite of her illness, she went to work"; "Despite being ill, she went to work"; "In spite of the fact that she was ill, she went to work".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 13) “尽管”和“尽管”后面可以跟哪三件事？给我一个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “尽管”和“尽管”后面可以跟名词、“-ing”或“dsshdu”。例如，“尽管她生病了，她还是去上班了”； “尽管生病了，她还是去上班了”； “尽管她生病了，她还是去上班了”。

drillParagraphs.question: 14) When do we use a reflexive pronoun? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use a reflexive pronoun when the subject and the object are the same person or thing. For example, "I looked at myself in the mirror".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 14) 什么时候使用反身代词？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当主语和宾语是同一个人或事物时，我们使用反身代词。例如，“我看着镜子里的自己”。

drillParagraphs.question: 15) What are the reflexive pronouns?
drillParagraphs.answer: The reflexive pronouns are "myself", "yourself", "himself", "herself", "itself", "oneself", "ourselves", "yourselves", and "themselves".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 15) 什么是反身代词？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 反身代词有“我自己”、“你自己”、“他自己”、“她自己”、“它自己”、“自己”、“我们自己”、“你们自己”和“他们自己”。

drillParagraphs.question: 16) What is the most common way to communicate purpose in English?
drillParagraphs.answer: Give me an example. The most common way to communicate purpose in English is by using the infinitive with "to". For example, "I went to the hospital to see a doctor".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 16) 用英语表达目的的最常见方式是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 举个例子。在英语中表达目的的最常见方法是使用带“to”的不定式。例如“我去医院看医生”。

drillParagraphs.question: 17) What's the difference between "to point at" and "to point out"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The difference between "to point at" and "to point out" is that we use "to point at" for the action of pointing the finger at an object, whereas "to point out" means to indicate something among different things.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 17) “指出”和“指出”有什么区别？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “to point at”和“to point out”之间的区别在于，我们使用“point at”来表示将手指指向某个物体的动作，而“to point out”则意味着在不同的事物中指示某事物。

drillParagraphs.question: 18) What do the words "may" and "might" express?
drillParagraphs.answer: The words "may" and "might" express the idea of "perhaps".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 18) “可能”和“可能”这两个词表达什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “可能”和“也许”这两个词表达了“也许”的意思。

drillParagraphs.question: 19) What's the difference between "may" and "might"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The difference between "may" and "might" is that we cannot use "may" in the 2nd conditional.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 19) “可能”和“可能”有什么区别？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “may”和“might”之间的区别在于我们不能在第二个条件中使用“may”。

drillParagraphs.question: 20) What does it mean when we add the word "back" to a verb? Give me?
drillParagraphs.answer: some examples. When we add the word "back" to a verb it means "to return". For example, "give back", "go back", "pay back" etc.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 20) 当我们在动词后面加上“back”这个词是什么意思？给我？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 一些例子。当我们将“back”一词添加到动词后时，它的意思是“返回”。例如“还给”、“回去”、“偿还”等。

drillParagraphs.question: 21) When do we use the past perfect? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the past perfect when we are thinking about time before and up to another point in the past. For example, "Mary could not enter her flat yesterday because she had lost her key".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 21) 我们什么时候使用过去完成时？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们思考过去的某个时间点之前和之前的时间时，我们会使用过去完成时。例如，“玛丽昨天无法进入她的公寓，因为她丢失了钥匙”。

drillParagraphs.question: 26) What's the difference between "allow" and "let"? Give me an?
drillParagraphs.answer: example of each. The difference between "allow" and "let" is that "allow" has the infinitive with "to" after it, whereas "let" has the infinitive without "to" after it. For example, "The doctor allowed me to change my appointment" and "The doctor let me change my appointment".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 26) “允许”和“让”有什么区别？给我一个？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 每个的例子。 “allow”和“let”之间的区别在于“allow”后面有不定式“to”，而“let”后面有不定式“to”。例如，“医生允许我更改预约”和“医生让我更改预约”。

drillParagraphs.question: 27) What's the most common way to speak about our habits? Give me an?
drillParagraphs.answer: example. The most common way to speak about our habits is to use the present simple or past simple. For example, "I play football every weekend"; "I always studied hard before exams at university".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 27) 谈论我们的习惯最常见的方式是什么？给我一个？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 例子。谈论我们的习惯的最常见方式是使用现在简单或过去简单。例如，“我每个周末都踢足球”； “我在大学考试前总是努力学习”。

drillParagraphs.question: 28) What's the difference between "travel" and "journey"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The difference between "travel" and "journey" is that we generally use "travel" as a verb and "journey" as a noun.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 28) “旅行”和“旅程”有什么区别？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “旅行”和“旅程”的区别在于，我们一般使用“旅行”作为动词，而“旅程”作为名词。

drillParagraphs.question: 29) What's the difference between the words "remember" and "remind"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The difference between the words "remember" and "remind" is that we remember something ourselves, without help, whereas, if we forget something, somebody reminds us. In other words, they remember for us.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 29）“记住”和“提醒”这两个词有什么区别？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “记住”和“提醒”这两个词之间的区别在于，我们自己记住某件事，无需帮助，而如果我们忘记某事，有人会提醒我们。换句话说，他们为我们记住。

drillParagraphs.question: 30) What's the difference between "to" and "at"? Give me an example of?
drillParagraphs.answer: each. The difference between "to" and "at" is that we generally use "to" when we are moving in the direction of something, or somewhere, and "at" when we are there. For example, "I'm going to the table. Now, I'm at the table".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 30) “到”和“在”有什么区别？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 每个。 “to”和“at”之间的区别在于，当我们朝某物或某处的方向移动时，我们通常使用“to”，而当我们在那里时则使用“at”。例如，“我要去餐桌旁。现在，我在餐桌旁”。

drillParagraphs.question: 31) When do we use the 3rd conditional? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the 3rd conditional when we are imagining something in the past that did not really happen. For example, "If I had not come to school last week, I would have stayed at home".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 31) 我们什么时候使用第三个条件？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们想象过去并未真正发生的事情时，我们使用第三个条件。例如，“如果我上周没有来学校，我就会呆在家里”。

drillParagraphs.question: 32) In the 3rd conditional, what do we put after the word "would"? Give?
drillParagraphs.answer: me some examples. In the 3rd conditional, we put the word "have" and the past participle after the word "would". For example, "he would have slept"; "she would have written"; "they would have eaten".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 32) 在第三个条件句中，我们在“would”后面加上什么？给？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我举一些例子。在第三个条件句中，我们将“have”一词和过去分词放在“would”一词后面。例如，“他本来会睡觉的”； “她会写的”； “他们会吃的”。

drillParagraphs.question: 34) How do we form the possessive case of a plural noun which already ends in "s"? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We form the possessive case of a plural noun which already ends in "s" just by adding an apostrophe, but no "s". For example, "The girls' coats".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 34) 我们如何构成已经以“s”结尾的复数名词的所有格？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们只需添加撇号即可形成已经以“s”结尾的复数名词的所有格，但不添加“s”。例如，“女孩的外套”。

drillParagraphs.question: 35) When do we use the words "they", "them" etc. to talk about just one person? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the words "they", "them" etc. to talk about just one person when we don't know if the person is a man or woman. For example, "There is somebody at the door. Go and see what they want".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 35) 我们什么时候使用“they”、“them”等词来谈论一个人？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们不知道一个人是男人还是女人时，我们会使用“他们”、“他们”等词来谈论一个人。例如，“门口有人，去看看他们想要什么”。

drillParagraphs.question: 36) What's the grammatical difference between "would rather" and "would prefer"? Give me an example of each?
drillParagraphs.answer: The grammatical difference between "would rather" and "would prefer" is that we put the infinitive without "to" after "would rather", whereas we put the infinitive with "to" after "would prefer". For example, "I would rather drink tea" and "I would prefer to drink tea".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 36) “wouldrather”和“wouldprefer”之间有什么语法区别？给我一个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “wouldrather”和“wouldprefer”之间的语法差异在于，我们将不带“to”的不定式放在“wouldrather”之后，而我们将带“to”的不定式放在“wouldprefer”之后。例如，“我宁愿喝茶”和“我宁愿喝茶”。

drillParagraphs.question: 37) What are two common uses of the future simple? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: of each. Two common uses of the future simple are to communicate that we have just this moment decided to do something, and to make a prediction. For example, "Sorry I forgot to bring the money for you; I'll bring it tomorrow, I promise!" and "I can't remember what she looks like but I'm sure I'll recognize her when I see her".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 37) 一般将来时的两种常见用法是什么？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 每一个。一般将来时的两个常见用途是传达我们此刻决定做某事，以及做出预测。例如，“抱歉，我忘了给你带钱；我保证明天会给你带来！” “我不记得她长什么样，但我确信当我看到她时我会认出她”。

drillParagraphs.question: 38) What are two common uses of "to be going to"? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: of each, please. Two common uses of "to be going to" are to make a prediction using information we already have, and to communicate a future intention. For example, "Be careful; that wine glass is going to fall off the table!" and "I'm going to go to the cinema next Saturday".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 38) “to be go to”有哪两种常见用法？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 请逐一列出。 “to be go to”的两个常见用法是使用我们已有的信息进行预测，以及传达未来的意图。例如，“小心，那个酒杯要从桌子上掉下来了！”和“下周六我要去电影院”。

drillParagraphs.question: 39) When do we use the auxiliary verb "do" in a positive sentence with the present simple tense?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the auxiliary verb "do" in a positive sentence with the present simple tense when we want to be emphatic.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 39) 什么时候在一般现在时的肯定句中使用助动词“do”？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们想要强调时，我们在肯定句中使用助动词“do”和现在简单时态。

drillParagraphs.question: 40) When do we usually use the emphatic "do"? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We usually use the emphatic "do" when we want to deny something that someone has said because we know it is not true. For example, if somebody says "You don't eat enough vegetables", I can reply "Yes I do eat enough vegetables!"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 40) 我们通常什么时候使用强调“do”？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们因为知道某人所说的事情不是真的而想要否认某些事情时，我们通常会使用强调的“do”。例如，如果有人说“你没有吃足够的蔬菜”，我可以回答“是的，我确实吃足够的蔬菜！”

drillParagraphs.question: 41) What is another use of the emphatic "do"? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: Another use of the emphatic "do" is in an exclamation. For example, "I do hate noisy children".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 41) 强调“do”的另一个用法是什么？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 强调“do”的另一种用法是在感叹句中。例如，“我确实讨厌吵闹的孩子”。

drillParagraphs.question: 42) How do we form the future perfect?
drillParagraphs.answer: We form the future perfect with the verb "to have" and a past participle.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 42) 我们如何形成将来完成时？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们用动词“to have”和过去分词构成将来完成时。

drillParagraphs.question: 43) When do we use the future perfect? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the future perfect when we are thinking about time before and up to a point in the future. For example, "When you arrive at my house, I'll have cooked dinner".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 43) 我们什么时候使用将来完成时？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们思考之前和未来某个时刻时，我们会使用将来完成时。例如，“当你到我家时，我会做饭”。

drillParagraphs.question: 46) What do we do with the tenses when we change direct speech into indirect speech? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: When we change direct speech into indirect speech, we generally move the verb into the past. For example: The teacher said "The room is large". The teacher said that the room was large.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 46) 当我们将直接引语改为间接引语时，我们如何处理时态？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们将直接引语改为间接引语时，我们通常会将动词移至过去时。例如：老师说“房间很大”。老师说房间很大。

drillParagraphs.question: 47) What do we do if a verb is already in the past?
drillParagraphs.answer: If a verb is already in the past, it often remains unchanged, but sometimes we put it further into the past.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 47) 如果动词已经过去了怎么办？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 如果一个动词已经过去了，它通常保持不变，但有时我们会把它进一步变成过去时。

drillParagraphs.question: 48) What do we do with the word "will" when we change direct speech into indirect speech? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: When we change direct speech into indirect speech, we change the word "will" to "would". For example: She said that John would go to London next year.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 48) 当我们把直接引语改为间接引语时，我们如何处理“will”这个词？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们将直接引语改为间接引语时，我们将“will”一词更改为“would”。例如：她说约翰明年要去伦敦。

drillParagraphs.question: 49) What's the difference between the words "what" and "whatever"?
drillParagraphs.answer: Give me an example of "whatever". The difference between the words "what" and "whatever" is that we use the word "what" in a limited sense, whereas we use the word "whatever" in a more unlimited sense. For example, "If I could buy whatever I wanted, I'd buy …".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 49) “什么”和“无论什么”这两个词有什么区别？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 举个“随便”的例子。 “什么”和“无论什么”这两个词之间的区别在于，我们在有限的意义上使用“什么”这个词，而我们在更无限的意义上使用“什么”这个词。例如，“如果我可以买我想要的任何东西，我会买……”。

drillParagraphs.question: 50) Tell me four common ways in which we can make a suggestion. Four common ways in which we can make a suggestion are: Shall we wait for him?
drillParagraphs.answer: Let's wait for him. How (or What) about waiting for him? Why don't we wait for him?
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 50) 告诉我提出建议的四种常见方式。我们提出建议的常见方式有四种：我们要等他吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们等他吧。如何（或什么）等他？我们为什么不等他呢？

drillParagraphs.question: 51) How do we make the imperative in English? Give me some examples?
drillParagraphs.answer: We make the imperative in English by using the infinitive without "to". For example, "Give me the book!"; "Do it now!"; "Have a nice day!"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 51) 我们如何用英语表达祈使句？给我一些例子？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们在英语中使用不带“to”的不定式来构成祈使句。例如，“把书给我！”； “现在就做！”； “祝你今天过得愉快！”

drillParagraphs.question: 52) How do we make a negative imperative? Give me some examples?
drillParagraphs.answer: We make a negative imperative by putting the word "don't" before the infinitive. For example, "Don't give him the book!"; "Don't be late!"; "Don't forget to email me!"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 52) 我们如何使用否定祈使句？给我一些例子？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们通过在不定式前面加上“don't”一词来构成否定祈使句。例如，“不要给他这本书！”； “别迟到了！”； “别忘了给我发电子邮件！”

drillParagraphs.question: 53) How do we form the perfect continuous tenses? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We form the perfect continuous tenses by using the verb "have", the word "been", and the present participle of the main verb. For example, "I have been studying for two hours".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 53) 我们如何构成完成进行时态？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们通过使用动词“have”、单词“been”和主要动词的现在分词来形成完美连续时态。例如，“我已经学习了两个小时”。

drillParagraphs.question: 54) When do we use the present perfect continuous? Give me an?
drillParagraphs.answer: example. We use the present perfect continuous to say how long an action has been in progress so far. For example, "I have been living in this house for six months so far".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 54) 我们什么时候使用现在完成进行时？给我一个？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 例子。我们用现在完成进行时来表示一个动作到目前为止已经进行了多长时间。例如，“到目前为止，我已经在这所房子里住了六个月了”。

drillParagraphs.question: 55) When do we use the past perfect continuous? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the past perfect continuous to communicate the duration of an action up to a particular point in the past. For example, "I had been living in this house for one month when I bought my new bed".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 55) 我们什么时候使用过去完成进行时？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们使用过去完成进行时来表达动作持续到过去某个特定时间点的持续时间。例如，“当我买新床时，我已经在这所房子里住了一个月”。

drillParagraphs.question: 56) When do we use the future perfect continuous? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the future perfect continuous to communicate the duration of an action up to a particular point in the future. For example, "I will have been living in this house for eight months at the end of this year".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 56) 我们什么时候使用将来完成进行时？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们使用将来完成进行时来表达动作持续到未来某一特定点的持续时间。例如，“到今年年底，我将在这所房子里住八个月”。

drillParagraphs.question: 57) When do we use a tail question?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use a tail question when we believe something is true, and we want somebody to confirm that we are right.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 57）我们什么时候使用尾部问题？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当我们相信某件事是真的，并且希望有人证实我们是对的时，我们会使用尾部问题。

drillParagraphs.question: 58) How do we form a tail question? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We form a tail question by repeating the first auxiliary verb from the main part of the sentence, and putting it in question form. For example, "He is going to go out tonight, isn't he?"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 58）我们如何形成尾部问题？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们通过重复句子主要部分的第一个助动词，并将其置于问题形式来形成尾部疑问句。例如，“他今晚要出去，是吗？”

drillParagraphs.question: 59) When there is no auxiliary verb in the main part of the sentence, which verb do we use in the tail question? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: When there is no auxiliary verb in the main part of the sentence, we use "do" in the tail question. For example, "They come every Thursday, don't they?"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 59) 当句子的主体部分没有助动词时，我们在尾问中使用哪个动词？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当句子的主体部分没有助动词时，我们在尾疑问句中使用“do”。例如，“他们每个星期四都来，不是吗？”

drillParagraphs.question: 60) What does the structure "to have something done" communicate?
drillParagraphs.answer: Give me an example. The structure "to have something done" communicates that we don't do the action ourselves, but that somebody else does it for us. For example, "I don't cut my hair myself; I have my hair cut by a hairdresser".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 60）“完成某事”这个结构传达什么信息？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 举个例子。 “完成某事”的结构传达了我们自己不做某事，而是其他人为我们做的事情。例如，“我自己不剪头发；我让理发师剪头发”。

drillParagraphs.question: 61) What's the most important difference between "tell" and "say"? Give?
drillParagraphs.answer: me an example. The most important difference between "tell" and "say" is that after "tell" we indicate the person we are speaking to, but after "say" we usually do not. For example: She told him that it was important. She said it was important.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 61）“告诉”和“说”之间最重要的区别是什么？给？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我举个例子。 “tell”和“say”之间最重要的区别是，在“tell”之后我们表示我们正在交谈的人，但在“say”之后我们通常不表示。例如：她告诉他这很重要。她说这很重要。

drillParagraphs.question: 62) After the verb "say", how is it possible to indicate the person we are speaking to?
drillParagraphs.answer: After the verb "say", it is possible to indicate the person we are speaking to by using the word "to".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 62) 在动词“say”之后，如何表示我们正在交谈的人？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 在动词“say”之后，可以使用“to”一词来表示我们正在交谈的人。

drillParagraphs.question: 63) For direct speech, which verb do we normally use: "say" or "tell"?
drillParagraphs.answer: Give me an example. For direct speech, we normally use the verb "say". For example: She said "I'm hungry".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 63) 对于直接引语，我们通常使用哪个动词：“say”或“tell”？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 举个例子。对于直接引语，我们通常使用动词“say”。例如：她说“我饿了”。

drillParagraphs.question: 64) What are the two basic types of auxiliary verb in English?
drillParagraphs.answer: The two basic types of auxiliary verb in English are primary auxiliaries and modal auxiliaries.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 64) 英语助动词有哪两种基本类型？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 英语助动词的两种基本类型是主要助动词和情态助动词。

drillParagraphs.question: 65) What are the primary auxiliaries?
drillParagraphs.answer: The primary auxiliaries are the verbs "be", "have" and "do".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 65) 主要助剂有哪些？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 主要助动词是动词“be”、“have”和“do”。

drillParagraphs.question: 66) When do we use the auxiliary "be"? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the auxiliary "be" to make the continuous tenses and the passive voice. For example, "I am speaking English now" and "This book was printed in England".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 66) 我们什么时候使用助动词“be”？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们使用助词“be”来构成进行时态和被动语态。例如，“我现在说英语”和“这本书是在英国印刷的”。

drillParagraphs.question: 68) When do we use the auxiliary "do"? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We use the auxiliary "do" for the present simple and past simple. For example, "I don't speak Spanish" and "Did she eat the pasta?"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 68) 我们什么时候使用助动词“do”？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们使用助动词“do”来表示一般现在时和一般过去时。例如，“我不会说西班牙语”和“她吃了意大利面吗？”

drillParagraphs.question: 69) What are the ten common modals?
drillParagraphs.answer: The ten common modals are "can", "could", "will", "would", "may", "might", "shall", should", "must" and "ought".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 69) 十种常见情态动词是什么？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 十个常见情态动词是“can”、“could”、“will”、“would”、“may”、“might”、“shall”、“should”、“must”和“ought”。

drillParagraphs.question: 70) What do we put after a modal? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We put the infinitive without "to" after a modal. For example, "I must send this email today".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 70) 情态动词后面放什么？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我们把不带“to”的不定式放在情态动词后面。例如，“我今天必须发送这封电子邮件”。

drillParagraphs.question: 71) Which modal is the only exception to this rule? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: "Ought" is the only exception to this rule. For example, "I ought to see a doctor".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 71) 哪种模式是这条规则的唯一例外？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “应该”是这条规则的唯一例外。例如，“我应该去看医生”。

drillParagraphs.question: 73) What does "by the time" mean in that sentence?
drillParagraphs.answer: "By the time" in that sentence means at some point between now and when she gets here.
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 73) 这句话中的“到时候”是什么意思？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 这句话中的“到时候”是指从现在到她到达这里之间的某个时刻。

drillParagraphs.question: 74) What's the difference between the words "older" and "elder"?
drillParagraphs.answer: The difference between the words "older" and "elder" is that we generally use the word "elder" when speaking about people in the same family, and we cannot say "elder than"
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 74) “年长”和“长辈”这两个词有什么区别？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: “older”和“elder”这两个词的区别在于，我们在谈论同一家庭的人时，一般用“elder”这个词，而不能说“elder than”

drillParagraphs.question: 75) When do we double the final consonant of an adjective in forming its comparative and its superlative? Give me an example?
drillParagraphs.answer: We double the final consonant of an adjective in forming its comparative and its superlative when it ends in a single consonant preceded by a single vowel. For example, "thin – thinner than – the thinnest".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 75) 我们什么时候将形容词的最后辅音加倍以形成其比较级和最高级？给我举个例子吗？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 当形容词以单个辅音结尾且前面有一个元音时，我们将形容词的最后辅音加倍，以形成其比较级和最高级。例如“薄——比——最薄”。

drillParagraphs.question: 76) What happens when an adjective ends in a consonant plus "y"? Give?
drillParagraphs.answer: me an example. When an adjective ends in a consonant plus "y", the "y" is changed to "i". For example, "lucky – luckier than – the luckiest".
drillParagraphs.questionZh: 76) 当形容词以辅音加“y”结尾时会发生什么？给？
drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我举个例子。当形容词以辅音加“y”结尾时，“y”变为“i”。例如，“幸运——比——最幸运的人更幸运”。

drillParagraphs.answer: my dinner" and "At 9 o'clock, I will have eaten my dinner"

drillParagraphs.answerZh: 我的晚餐”和“9点钟，我会吃完晚餐”

questions.questionTextZh: 如何构成完美进行时态？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 我们通过使用动词“have”、单词“been”和主要动词的现在分词来形成……

questions.questionText: When do we use the present perfect continuous?
questions.expectedAnswer: We use the present perfect continuous to say how long an action has been in progress so far
questions.questionTextZh: 我们什么时候使用现在完成进行时？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 我们用现在完成进行时来表示一个动作到目前为止已经进行了多长时间

questions.questionText: What are the three forms of "run"?
questions.expectedAnswer: The three forms of "run" are "run, ran, run"
questions.questionTextZh: “跑”有哪三种形式？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: “跑”的三种形式是“跑、跑、跑”

questions.questionText: What's the furthest you've ever run?
questions.expectedAnswer: The furthest I've ever run is … grow – grew – grown
questions.questionTextZh: 你跑过最远的距离是多少？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 我跑过的最远距离是……成长——成长——成长

questions.questionText: What does the structure "to have something done" communicate?
questions.expectedAnswer: The structure "to have something done" communicates that we don't do the action ourselves, but that somebody else does it for us
questions.questionTextZh: “完成某事”的结构传达了什么信息？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: “完成某事”的结构传达了我们自己不执行该操作，而是其他人为我们执行的操作

questions.questionText: Do you clean your shoes yourself or do you have them cleaned by someone else?
questions.expectedAnswer: I clean my shoes myself ~ I don't clean my shoes myself; I have them cleaned by someone else
questions.questionTextZh: 你的鞋子是自己洗还是请别人洗？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 我自己擦鞋～我自己不擦鞋；我让别人清理它们

questions.questionText: What's the most important difference between "tell" and "say"?
questions.expectedAnswer: The most important difference between "tell" and "say" is that after "tell" we indicate the person we are speaking to, but after "say" we usually do not
questions.questionTextZh: “告诉”和“说”之间最重要的区别是什么？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: “tell”和“say”之间最重要的区别是，在“tell”之后我们表示我们正在交谈的人，但在“say”之后我们通常不表示

questions.questionText: After the verb "say", how is it possible to indicate the person we are speaking to?
questions.expectedAnswer: After the verb "say", it's possible to indicate the person we are speaking to by using the word "to" With direct speech, we normally use the verb "say", and not "tell". For example: He said "I will see you tomorrow".
questions.questionTextZh: 在动词“say”之后，如何才能表示我们正在说话的人呢？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 在动词“say”之后，可以使用“to”一词来指示我们正在交谈的人。在直接引语中，我们通常使用动词“say”，而不是“tell”。例如：他说“明天见”。

questions.questionText: What are the two basic types of auxiliary verb in English?
questions.expectedAnswer: The two basic types of auxiliary verb in English are primary auxiliaries and modal auxiliaries
questions.questionTextZh: 英语助动词有哪两种基本类型？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 英语助动词的两种基本类型是主助动词和情态助动词

questions.questionText: What are the primary auxiliaries?
questions.expectedAnswer: The primary auxiliaries are the verbs "be", "have" and "do" We use the auxiliary "be" to make the continuous tenses, for example when we say "I am speaking English now". We also use it for the passive voice, for example when we say "This book was printed in England".
questions.questionTextZh: 主要辅助剂有哪些？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 主要助动词是动词“be”、“have”和“do”。我们使用助动词“be”来构成进行时态，例如当我们说“我现在正在说英语”时。我们也将它用于被动语态，例如当我们说“这本书是在英国印刷的”时。

questions.questionText: What does "by the time" mean in that sentence?
questions.expectedAnswer: "By the time" in that sentence means at some point between now and when she gets here
questions.questionTextZh: 这句话中的“到时候”是什么意思？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 这句话中的“到时候”是指从现在到她到达这里之间的某个时刻

questions.questionText: By the time you are ninety years old, do you suppose your hair will be grey?
questions.expectedAnswer: Yes, by the time I'm ninety years old, I suppose my …
questions.questionTextZh: 到你九十岁的时候，你认为你的头发会变白吗？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 是的，当我九十岁的时候，我想我的……

questions.questionText: What's my hand doing?
questions.expectedAnswer: Your hand is appearing and disappearing (from under the table)
questions.questionTextZh: 我的手在做什么？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 你的手时隐时现（从桌子底下）

questions.questionText: Does it appear to you that people in the world are becoming happier or less happy?
questions.expectedAnswer: It appears to me that happier
questions.questionTextZh: 在您看来，世界上的人们是变得更快乐还是更不快乐？
questions.expectedAnswerZh: 在我看来更快乐
